definitions.explanation: The period of heavy rain in early summer in Japan.

examples.japanese: {梅雨|つゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.notes: {梅雨|つゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ is a set expression for the start of the rainy season.

examples.japanese: ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{梅雨|つゆ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あ}けた→明ける：21288_akeru⟧。
examples.english: The rainy season has finally ended.
examples.notes: {梅雨|つゆ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あ}ける→明ける：21288_akeru⟧ is a set expression for the end of the rainy season.

examples.japanese: {梅雨|つゆ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}きにくくて→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: During the rainy season, it's hard to get laundry dry, which is a pain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{梅雨|つゆ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧のように⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{出|で}かけている→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: This year's rainy season has been very wet, so I've been taking an umbrella almost every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空梅雨|からつゆ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦{降|ふ}らなかった→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水不足|みずぶそく}→水不足：15397_mizubusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}している→心配：00811_shinpai⟧。
examples.english: This year was a dry rainy season with almost no rain, so farmers are worried about water shortages.
examples.notes: ⟦{空梅雨|からつゆ}→空梅雨：noentry⟧ means a rainy season with very little rain.

notes:
{梅雨|つゆ} is Japan's rainy season, typically lasting from early June to mid-July.

ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "plum rain" — the rainy season coincides with the ripening of ⟦{梅|うめ}→梅：01869_ume⟧ (plums). Also read ばいう in the compound ⟦{梅雨前線|ばいうぜんせん}→梅雨前線：24972_tsuyuzensen⟧ (rainy season front).

KEY EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{梅雨入|つゆい}り→梅雨入り：08337_tsuyuiri⟧: the start of the rainy season
- ⟦{梅雨明|つゆあ}け→梅雨明け：08338_tsuyuake⟧: the end of the rainy season
- ⟦{空梅雨|からつゆ}→空梅雨：27795_karatsuyu⟧: a dry rainy season (less rain than usual)
- ⟦{梅雨前線|ばいうぜんせん}→梅雨前線：24972_tsuyuzensen⟧: the seasonal rain front

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
The rainy season is a significant part of Japanese life, affecting daily routines, agriculture, and mood. ⟦{紫陽花|あじさい}→紫陽花：04997_ajisai⟧ (hydrangeas) are the iconic flower of {梅雨|つゆ} season.
